about: Quantization variants staged for the on-device latency sweep (DeviceLatencyBenchmark). Generated by src/training/make_app_bundle.py; the *.tflite files are gitignored and must be regenerated locally.
host_latency_caveat: host_latency_ms_devcpu is single-threaded x86 dev CPU from the conversion spike. It is the number the device run exists to replace, not a target.
accuracy_caveat: tflite_accuracy_sample is the spike's 200-image figure — a conversion-fidelity check, not an architecture comparison.
